script:
Sister Wang (Pawn Shop Owner's Wife)
Sister Wang is the wife of Yao Qianshu, the pawn shop owner in town. Three years ago, Yao Qianshu suddenly told Sister Wang that he was about to make big money. The newcomers to town, Wang Er and Wang Mei, had stolen something from a wealthy family, and now that family had tracked them down. He wanted to sell this information for money. Sister Wang felt uneasy and told him not to get involved in these matters. But Yao Qianshu didn't listen to her advice and got involved anyway. As a result, the wealthy family indeed took action and burned those two people alive in their house.
Sister Wang had a conflict with Yao Qianshu over this. She felt that Yao Qianshu causing the death of two people for money was too heartless. But Sister Wang discovered that not only did Yao Qianshu show no remorse, he also spent money lavishly outside every day, getting drunk with Zhang, the gas station owner in town. Several times, Sister Wang even found women's hair on Yao Qianshu's clothes. Only then did she realize that Yao Qianshu had found a mistress outside.
Once, Boss Zhang brought the drunk Yao Qianshu home and seemed very interested in Sister Wang. Sister Wang, partly out of revenge and partly feeling emotionally empty, also began flirting with Boss Zhang. Later, the two confirmed this underground romance, often meeting at the tavern on the other side of town - Sister Wang entering through the front door, Boss Zhang through the back door.
Nanny Jia in town is Sister Wang's good friend. Nanny Jia is a gossip. Two years ago, a wealthy family moved to town, named Li Changqing. Li Changqing hired Jia to work as his nanny. Nanny Jia told Sister Wang that this Li Changqing had half his face burned and looked very frightening. He also had a crazy wife named Li Meimei, who was a local woman. When Sister Wang asked who she was and if she had seen her before, Nanny Jia was evasive, very unlike her usual gossipy nature.
One day, Yao Qianshu came home drunk again. Sister Wang was very angry and scolded him for drinking all day and not doing proper work. But Yao Qianshu told her he was about to get rich, and when he had money, who would dare say he wasn't doing proper work? Sister Wang remembered what happened three years ago and felt that Yao Qianshu was definitely up to no good again. After some probing, she learned that Yao Qianshu had somehow gotten a bag of gems that could be worth ten to twenty million when sold. She knew Yao Qianshu wouldn't let her share this money, so she told Boss Zhang and asked him to find a way to get the gems.
On August 20th, Yao Qianshu told Sister Wang that he had found a buyer and would soon sell the gems. Sister Wang was very anxious, afraid that Yao Qianshu would run away with the money. She wanted to stop Yao Qianshu and said to him, "Back then you caused the death of those two people for money, and now you're going to get yourself killed for money too." But Yao Qianshu didn't care. Sister Wang had no choice but to mock him, saying, "When you die, the money will all be mine."
On the evening of August 25th, Sister Wang was helping Yao Qianshu pack his clothes when she found a piece of paper in his clothes that read "August 30th, 11 PM, South Town Clock Tower." She understood this was probably the time for the transaction. As the final deadline, Sister Wang had no choice but to quickly find Boss Zhang and tell him about this, also telling him that if necessary, just kill Yao Qianshu.
[August 30th]
Around 10:40 PM, it started raining heavily. Yao Qianshu hurriedly left the house. Sister Wang was about to go to Boss Zhang's house to wait for news when Nanny Jia came to her house and kept talking about everything except what mattered. Sister Wang, having something on her mind, looked at Nanny Jia with strange eyes.
After Nanny Jia got up and left, it was already 10:55. Sister Wang waited at home for a while. Seeing that Yao Qianshu hadn't returned and estimating that something had happened, she went to Boss Zhang's residence.
At 11:30, she arrived at Boss Zhang's house and saw Boss Zhang dragging something from his car. Sister Wang was still afraid of being directly involved in this matter, so she turned around and went home.
The next day, Boss Zhang came to Sister Wang's house, gave her a bag of gems, and told her that he hadn't heard any news about Yao Qianshu yet, asking her to quickly pack up and prepare to escape.
Only Clue (Not actively exposing +10 points):
Saw Boss Zhang dragging something from his car.
